trifecta_diagnostics.interpretation: hit_rate is winning tickets divided by tickets; race_hit_rate is races with at least one winning ticket divided by races. ROI confidence intervals use a race-level normal ratio approximation and are diagnostic, not a promotion guarantee. Role coverage and ticket ROI are reported separately.

formation_2_4_5.allocation_method: Exploratory rank-weighted allocation with the same total stake per race as 100-yen equal staking. Historical pre-off trio combination odds are unavailable, so these policies are not expected-value or Kelly staking.

trio_diagnostics.interpretation: Trio tickets are unordered combinations. hit_rate is winning tickets divided by tickets; race_hit_rate is races with at least one winning ticket divided by races. ROI confidence intervals use a race-level normal ratio approximation and are diagnostic, not a promotion guarantee. Top5 is the unchanged fixed baseline. formation_2_4_5 is top2 / top4 / ranks3-7 with duplicate unordered combinations removed. Allocation policies keep the same race-level stake and reweight 100-yen units by model rank; they are exploratory, not EV staking.

frame_ablation.comparison_policy: Same chronological holdout races, same learned base weights, same D performance/pace features and identical tickets. Only the prior frame-context 8% blend is removed.

method.weight_policy: Uses the learned B-model weights, removes one feature, then renormalizes remaining weights to sum to 1. The ablated models are not independently refitted.
method.market_data: Official final confirmed odds are retrospective only and were not available before the race. This is a market benchmark, not a live pre-off comparison.
method.selection: All model and market picks are compared on the same holdout races with available official final odds.
method.production_impact: Diagnostic only. No live model weights, predictions, or G4 preregistered value thresholds are changed.
method.interpretation: Compare winner_top1_rate first. A feature whose removal improves the top-1 rate is a candidate for deeper review, not automatic deletion. Check sample size and uncertainty before any change.
